reviewItem.question: If an exposed environment does nothing about "Backward compatibility: Crossplane v2 makes the following breaking changes: - It removes native patch and transform composition", what happens, and is that review or action? proposed: upgrade-blocked

consequence.statement: Package installation commands that rely on the --registry flag to specify a default registry will fail in Crossplane v2.0.0; fully qualified package URLs must be provided explicitly.

proposed.statement: Crossplane v2.0.0 removes the --registry CLI flag, requiring users to always specify fully qualified URLs when installing packages instead of relying on a default registry value.
